title: zellerlab/flexprofiler pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be a string or an integer and cannot contain spaces

run_accession.errorMessage: Run accession must be provided and cannot contain spaces.

instrument_platform.errorMessage: Sequencing platform must be ILLUMINA or PACBIO_SMRT (ENA controlled vocabulary): the other platforms are not supported.

library_strategy.errorMessage: Library strategy must be WGS or AMPLICON (ENA controlled vocabulary), or left empty for WGS.

fastq_1.errorMessage: Gzipped FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: Gzipped FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'. If not applicable, leave it empty.
